newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-BORDER BEAT WESTERN TRANSVAAL 33-26.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-BORDER BEAT WESTERN TRANSVAAL 33-26.

text.p: Border beat Western Transvaal 33-26 (halftime 23-17) in their Currie Cup rugby match in Potchefstroom on Saturday.
The home-side were always trailing after Border got off to a flying start with the first of two tries from fullback Russell Bennett in the sixth minute.
Greg Miller converted to add to the penalty he kicked in the second minute and give his side a 10- lead.
Border fought back with tries from wing Rudi Muller and loose-head prop Andre Coetzer but were not able to overcome the early deficit.
Western Transvaal - Tries: Rudi Muller, Andre Coetzer. Conversions: Johan Mostert (2). Penalties: Mostert (4).
Border - Tries: Russell Bennett (2), Andre Claassen. Conversions: Greg Miller (3). Penalties: Miller (4).
